name: OpenLDAP
description: Full OpenLDAP directory server (slapd) for apps that need standard LDAP schemas. No web interface; reachable only on its private network and, if you choose, on this PC.

volumes.name: data
volumes.description: Directory database (MDB). Must be a Docker volume.

inputs.label: Directory domain
inputs.help: Becomes the base DN, e.g. example.com -> dc=example,dc=com.

inputs.label: Open LDAP on this PC (127.0.0.1:3389)
inputs.help: For LDAP tools on this PC. Other apps reach it on the shared private network only when you connect them deliberately.

security: LDAP is never published through Traefik or Cloudflare; port 389 is unencrypted, so keep it on private networks.
The administrator password is used only when the directory is first created.

notes: A directory, not a web app: applications sign in to it with LDAP binds.

limitations: The container comes from a small vendor (intechcore) that packages the official Symas OpenLDAP 2.6 LTS builds; osixia/openldap is unmaintained and the free Bitnami images were withdrawn.
No web interface: manage entries with LDAP tools (ldapadd, Apache Directory Studio) or use LLDAP for a simpler directory with a web interface.
The open-file limit is set to 1024: slapd otherwise sizes its memory by Docker's very high default and used about 670 MB in testing.
manualSetup: Create organisational units, users and groups with LDAP tools (for example Apache Directory Studio against 127.0.0.1:3389 when local access is on).

update.notes: Back up before updates: the MDB database and cn=config are in two volumes.

testStatus.notes: Installed in isolation (headless): health, its own check (cscli lapi status / ldapwhoami as cn=admin), network isolation, modular stack, stop/start, backup and restore, removal with data. No web route (by design).
